description: Do you have recursive hierarchical data that you can't display in Power BI? Do you need to present a bill of materials or a parts list? Do you want to visualize your employees with their managers in an intuitive way? Do you work with other parent-child hierarchies? If so, the Recursive Hierarchy Table is perfect for you! This visual enables you to display such data in a clear and organized view directly in Power BI! Users can intuitively interact with the data since the visual resembles a standard Power BI Matrix and offers many of the same customization options. They can: Scroll through the data Collapse and expand rows Sort by any column Select an item along with all its children Would you rather display your data in a chart? We also offer a second visual: the Recursive Hierarchy Chart, which visually resembles a decomposition tree. The table visualization is better for quickly getting detailed information about your items and analyzing their parents/children. The chart visualization, on the other hand, is better for a graphic overview of all items and analyzing key drivers. The free version offers full support for any hierarchy level but allows only one additional attribute. In the full version, there are no restrictions, enabling you to add multiple attributes such as part designations, price details, dates, and more.
